title: 어떻게 한국에 오게 됐어요? 삶의 변화 말하기
objective: By the end, you can use V-게 되다 in the present, past, future and negative to say how a situation changed your life (for example, 한국에 오게 됐어요). You can also choose between -게 되다 for verbs and -아/어지다 for adjectives.
summary: Learn how to use V-게 되다 to talk about changes and results that happened because of a situation, not only your own plan.

task.title: Use -게 되다 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then fill in, choose, or correct the form of -게 되다 as the instruction asks.

forms.when: Something usually happens over time because of a situation.
forms.means: you come to / end up doing
forms.example: 한국에 살면 매운 음식도 잘 먹게 돼요.
forms.exampleMeaning: If you live in Korea, you end up eating spicy food well too.

forms.when: A change or result already happened, often not by your own plan.
forms.example: 회사 일 때문에 한국에 오게 됐어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I came to Korea because of work.

forms.when: A change is decided or expected because of a situation.
forms.means: will end up doing / it turns out I will
forms.example: 다음 달부터 부산에서 일하게 될 거예요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm going to be working in Busan from next month.

forms.when: Something you planned can't happen anymore because of a situation.
forms.means: it turned out I can't / couldn't
forms.example: 갑자기 일이 생겨서 모임에 못 가게 됐어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Something suddenly came up, so it turns out I can't go to the meeting.

watchOut: 갔게 됐어요 (X) → 가게 됐어요 (O): Put the tense only on 되다. The verb before -게 never takes a tense marker (가다 → 가게, not 갔게).
결혼하게 됬어요 (X) → 결혼하게 됐어요 (O): 되었어요 becomes 됐어요. '됬' is not a Korean word.
날씨가 춥게 됐어요 (X) → 날씨가 추워졌어요 (O): For a change in an adjective (cold, warm, busy), use -아/어지다. Use -게 되다 with verbs.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 살다 + -게 되다 (past, polite): 남편이 한국 사람이라서 서울에서 ____.
Choose the correct form: 친구 소개로 지금 회사에 (다녔게 됐어요 / 다니게 됐어요).
Fill in the blank with 가르치다 + -게 되다 (future, polite): 다음 주부터 제가 이 반을 ____.
Choose the correct form: ① 히터를 켜서 방이 (따뜻하게 됐어요 / 따뜻해졌어요). ② 한국 친구가 생겨서 한국 음식을 자주 (먹게 됐어요 / 먹어졌어요).
Fill in the blank with 못 + 만나다 + -게 되다 (past, polite): 친구가 아파서 오늘 ____.
Find the spelling mistake and write the correct word: 저 다음 달에 결혼하게 됬어요.
